speaker: richard_quiney
text: Good countryman? Quiney. From the Bell.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard. I am at home. Say the errand.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: A week of ante-rooms, and I am hopeful. The town's paper is before those who can grant it. I look for an answer Monday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday. And until then the paper can do its own waiting.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Monday, supper, at six, at the Bell, and I'll stand the wine if the answer's yea, and you shall if it's nay.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I would have you bring any of your fellows that have a charitable purse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Players' purses are charitable to tapsters, Richard, and to nobody else in Christendom.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Then come alone and bring your own.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday at six. God keep you.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: And you. It is not a long supper I ask.
